title: The Lady and the Chest Press

text_block_list.text:
Early one afternoon while taking a break in the Trainer's office,
a completely crestfallen Mejiro Ryan came knocking on the door.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Tr-Trainerrr...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
T-To tell you the truth... I'm in a huge crisis.
It's so bad I can't even get my protein shakes down!
Saying so, Mejiro Ryan timidly held out a magazine.

On the cover was a full-page feature of Mejiro McQueen,
sipping black tea with an elegant, dignified pose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, yes, she looks amazing, but that's not it!
Look at the next page! Turn to the next page, please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "The Splendid Daughters of the Mejiro Family: Special Feature Part 1"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Splendid... daughters... of the Mejiro family... *laaa-dyyyy*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I just got a phone call asking for an interview...
Even though... I'm nothing like a proper lady such as McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Aargh! They're definitely expecting someone
who plays violin by the window... like McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ugh... well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back to what you said the other day...
I realized I should try things even if I feel like they're out of my wheelhouse.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I tried thinking about my own potential... but I just don't know.
To figure that out, I need to broaden my horizons!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So...! That's why
I really need you with me, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Are you mentally prepared, Trainer?!
This is McQueen's favorite, the forbidden shopping mall...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“VICTORIA” “Schimmel” “grooming”...
Whoa, it's nothing but ultra-classy, high-end brands!
choice_data_list: You sure know a lot about them.
You know a lot about these, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wah, no! I've just stared at fashion magazines until my eyes practically burned holes in them!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um... would it be okay if I just take a quick peek?
choice_data_list: Take all the time you need.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank you!

Mejiro Ryan walked along looking nervous, gazing into the shopfronts.
Eventually, she plucked up the courage to step inside.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Eep! A tulle miniskirt! With a ribbon on the back!
H-Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: My quads are so bulky, it probably... wouldn't look good on me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Frilly blouses are totally McQueen's thing.
Maybe I'll just hold it up to myself...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: N-No way... I can't pull this off~

Mejiro Ryan carefully picked up one garment after another,
letting out quiet gasps of delight followed by sighing disappointment.
Before long, she stopped in front of a knit sweater on display in one storefront.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Pink...
With refined, pearl-like jewel accents...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Normally, I'd never pick something like this in a million years, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No! Times like this call for a chest press mindset!
...I'm gonna try it on!

On our way back after shopping,
Mejiro Ryan seemed a bit restless.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: A pink knit sweater... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course! It's super cute, and it's gonna keep me motivated!
Though, that's kind of why...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I don't know... I'm just so nervous.
It's like my pecs are fluttering...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Was that a cat meowing?
Where is it coming from—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait, WAAAAAH?!

Near the top of a tall roadside tree ahead, there was a kitten.
Its claws were caught on a branch, leaving it dangling in mid-air.

And in the blink of an eye, it began to plummet.
The tree was thirty meters away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I've got it!

Mejiro Ryan was already sprinting full tilt,
clutching the newly bought knit sweater in one hand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Make it in tiiime!

Just inches before the kitten hit the ground,
Mejiro Ryan caught it safely in the outstretched knit sweater.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew—there you go. You're safe now.

The kitten seemed completely unharmed,
snuggling up warmly wrapped in Mejiro Ryan's sweater.
I helped Mejiro Ryan up and took the kitten, but—
The knit had frayed, likely snagged by the kitten's claws...
choice_data_list: Your new sweater got ruined, huh...
Looks like the sweater got ruined...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh. Nothing could be helped there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's funny, Trainer.
Right now... I actually feel kind of refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I got to go shopping with you and bought cute clothes...
but deep down, it didn't really feel like me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...I was definitely pushing myself too hard. Trying to act like McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: When my body just moved on instinct just now, it made me realize something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm "Mejiro Ryan," not "Mejiro McQueen."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I might admire girly, cute things even if they don't quite suit me...
but when it comes to athletic action, I won't lose to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...And being that kind of girl isn't so bad after all!
choice_data_list: Sounds like you discovered another side of your potential.
Looks like you found another piece of your potential.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I really hope so!
I'm going to do the interview in my usual gym uniform!

As Mejiro Ryan gave her reply, she looked more radiant than ever.
I heard later that the interview was a massive success!
